data_description.sms_after_receive: What to do with an incoming SMS on the modem once its event has fired. Delete keeps the modem storage from filling up.

sms_mark_read.name: Mark SMS as read
sms_mark_read.description: Marks inbox messages as read on the modem.

url.name: URL
url.description: URL of the router; optional when only one is configured.

index.name: Index
index.description: Message index, or a list of them (from the incoming SMS event).

sms_delete.name: Delete SMS
sms_delete.description: Deletes inbox messages on the modem.

url.name: URL
url.description: URL of the router; optional when only one is configured.

index.name: Index
index.description: Message index, or a list of them (from the incoming SMS event).

sms_delete_read.name: Delete read SMS
sms_delete_read.description: Deletes every read message in the modem inbox.

url.name: URL
url.description: URL of the router; optional when only one is configured.
